title: General Measurement Model. These also include Universal Life Elimisha and funeral plans.
columns:
Life insurance contracts that provide insurable benefits in the event
of death, sickness or disability, and that are measured using the
General Measurement Model. These also include Universal Life
contracts that have indirect participating features.

Retail pure risk products, e.g. Soma
plan, Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB)
Elimisha and funeral plans.
